summary: AI waste prediction develops a new integrating AI model system that can predict and detect the possible accumulation locations of the gathering wastes, it addresses the challenge of ( be an Earth system trend detective) which describes how the using the variable date to detect something, we use the API data from satellites to measure the accumulating locations of wastes. furthermore, it contains an algorithm that improve from the accuracy of the prediction.  Our solution is essential because the gathering of this may cause a tremendous losing of currency. such as what happens in Malaysia in 2021, where a big ship accidentally dropped an amount wastes approximately 14 million tons, causing losing of money equals 1.1 billion dollars.
details: AI waste prediction is an AI system that can predict the accumulation places of the wastes with a period of 72 hours, it works by using API from NASA which is the data collected from the satellite, in addition, it trains an AI to improve its accuracy of prediction between the actual places of the wastes and what it predicts, the benefits from this project are that the ability to hamper the disasters of dropping the wastes in the oceans causing tremendous lose in the currency, affecting in the marine creatures, the intended impact is to facilitate the process of gathering wastes before happening of any distributions can affect on the place of these wastes, and reducing from the losing of money. the tools used were VS code and node.js, the coding languages are html and json, our project is innovative and creative because it doesn't do normal process of detection only, it also predicts the accumulation possible places for a duration of 72 hours. we considered several factors by using the movement equations which are the wind movement and the waves movement
